hypothesis: Y036 found quorum2 harmful after a fixed bijective relabeling of exactly the same circular matching graph. Investigate whether arbitrary numeric cell ordering in the deterministic augmenting matcher causes this apparent topology dependence. A sorter canonicalized through the inverse cell permutation should exactly reproduce original reference assignments.
freeze: Fix the bijection, inverse, matcher sort order, active cohort, policies, controls and effect classification before original execution; do not tune after results.
graph: Exact same ring_reference 7 active / 16 motifs/cells / 9 inactive retained / 8 episodes and radius-two matching. Scramble cells via bijection observed_cell=(5*canonical_cell+3*seed) mod16; inverse canonical_cell=(13*(observed_cell-3*seed)) mod16.
models: reference_numeric: original ring graph sorted by native numeric cell label
scrambled_numeric: bijectively relabeled ring graph with native observed numeric sort (the Y036 treatment)
scrambled_canonical: same relabeled graph but matcher sorts candidates by recovered canonical cell id, preserving the same preference-first rule
metrics: Per mode/policy/seed/episode complete canonicalized seven-key allocation identity, returning-key churn, search call count, legal cache preference count, cache-write/occupancy parity, exhaustive Hall cardinality. Compare reference vs both scrambled modes at exact paired seed/episode/policy.
classification: COORDINATE_SORT_CONFOUND if scrambled_canonical has zero assignment mismatches to reference across all heldout episodes/policies AND scrambled_numeric has at least one assignment mismatch with a nonzero heldout churn difference for at least one policy. PARTIAL if canonical mismatches fewer than native scrambled but not zero. NO_CONFIRMED_CONFOUND otherwise. All outcome categories preserved.
controls: No future information/oracle/extra computational action budget; both matching modes use same augmenting matcher and cap9 cache
Canonicalization uses known bijection from harness; no hidden label access
No earlier heldout reuse; original first-use artifact then one full pytest regression
All keys and cache writes/occupancy parity within each policy/paired mode
No accepted-ref mutation or production activation
claim_limit: Synthetic label-equivariance of deterministic matching/tie-break, not semantic memory or intelligence.
